claim: Public MS clinical-reference sources describe relapsing-remitting MS as a disease course with distinct attacks followed by partial or complete recovery, and as the most common MS disease course.
future_grounding_route: Could be used only as clinical context or compared with future public disease-course metadata; it does not alter any project-grounded cohort labels or rules.
project_use: Public-reader disease-course context; not evidence for any project finding.

source.label: National MS Society Types of MS page

why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun a clinical society's public disease-course definitions from held data.
